articles.title: Russia launches largest attack on Ukraine energy infrastructure since spring
articles.description: In total 11 regions of the country were attacked overnight, with residential buildings and railways also targeted, the Ukrainian PM says.

articles.title: Girl has multiple surgeries to control infections after strike in Gaza
articles.description: Witnesses say Raseel's tent was hit by an Israeli helicopter strike. Israel’s military says it has no record of the attack.

articles.title: Restaurant named after Xi Jinping attacked by Chinese nationals in South Korea
articles.description: The owner said he chose the name because he wanted to run the "best Chinese restaurant" in South Korea.

articles.title: Kim Jong Un's sister issues warning as she denies South Korea land mine claims
articles.description: Kim Jong Un's sister has threatened retaliation and said claims North Korea planted land mines that injured three South Korean soldiers are a "conspiratorial farce".

articles.title: Morocco names first female prime minister after historic election victory
articles.description: Morocco has named its first-ever female prime minister, and only the second woman to hold the position in the Arab world, following an election.
